description: This file defines the Error class used for error handling, including methods for adding errors, rendering errors as HTML, and checking if errors exist.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: A class for managing error messages, including storing errors, generating HTML output, and checking for errors.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error message with command, message, line, and file information to the error list.

methods.name: ErrorsAsHTML
methods.description: Returns a HTML table string representing all logged errors, with warnings formatted separately.

methods.name: ErrorsExist
methods.description: Returns true if there are any errors logged, false otherwise.
